name: review_skill
description: Inspect a skill's prompt, tools, and runtime model context, and optionally persist a model-tuned variant. Call without 'content' to inspect; call with 'content' to write the adapted prompt.

skill_name.description: Skill name to review, or '*' for batch mode (returns list of all eligible skills)

content.description: Full adapted prompt content to persist as the model-tuned variant. Omit to inspect only.

dry_run.description: If true, return data for review without writing to disk

force.description: If true, overwrite an existing variant for the current model
